For any convex function (f'' >= 0), secants lie on or ABOVE the graph, not below. Sub-element deficits do not arise from a convex secant falling below the function.
true_mathematical_mechanisms: Piecewise-linear non-alignment: Donor field d_D(x) is piecewise linear on donor elements. Recipient elements cross donor element edges; linear interpolation between recipient nodes cannot identically match donor piecewise linearity across element cuts.

Candidate 3 heuristic failure: Candidate 3 uniformly elevated all nodes of any element containing any sub-element deficit by the maximum deficit. This indiscriminate nodal elevation across the process zone inflated fracture energy by +3.55% (+24.7 uJ), which is an algorithm-specific heuristic defect, not a proof of universal mathematical impossibility.
